target.scope: Cold homepage startup through document capture after five-second settle. Additional conversation/rich-content code after submission is outside this startup budget.

cohort.scope: Fresh browser coalition creation through native encoded document PNG. Driver workflow elapsed includes readiness/ownership, teardown, content audit and pixel comparison; it is not isolated page load time.
cohort.cache: Fresh private profile/cache per process; original-origin disk replay. OS filesystem/shader caches retained.

guard.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

cohort.instrumentation: Both variants use VOX_ADBLOCK_LOG and native cumulative/coalition counters. Filter tests briefly overlap the first control; other shared browser/build jobs contribute host contention. No trials excluded.

live.metric: Unique observed original script-response URLs joined to independently hashed immutable source bodies. This is a decoded-payload estimate, not a compressed wire-transfer counter; request coalescing is not inferred from repeated filter checks.
